Power|+25}} }} The '''Burglar's Shank''' is a [[Weapons#Dagger|dagger weapon]] that can be found as a [[The Mines#Special Items|special item drop]] on Floors 81-119 of [[The Mines]], in the [[Skull Cavern]], or in the [[Quarry Mine]] by killing [[The Mines#Special Items|special monsters]] or by breaking [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|crates and barrels]].
